name: Hard switch to a glowing mark alone in the dark
looks: The light paper field cuts hard to a near-black, finely dotted ground. The same small mark that was rolling now sits alone at the centre, glowing softly, the only object in the frame.
build: A hard field swap (no crossfade) from the light to the dark palette; cinematic-atmosphere-hold's single bloom sprite pinned centre-frame, pulsing slowly, with the fine dot grid as the static background layer.
sound: The roll tone cuts to silence on the hard switch, replaced by a low ambient hum.
prompt: Mark a turn in the story with a hard light-to-dark switch: cut the whole field from a light, busy ground to a near-black one, holding on the one recurring mark alone and glowing at the centre, with nothing else in frame.
